review.summary: Readiness is genuinely re-qualified at f9cebee: 105 registered commands, all exit 0, one continuous 15:25–15:57 run, including both `--require-directional` clean extracted packages (394 s/373 s, directional consumer executed externally with distinct executed-source digests) and `check-access-release.py --phase 28 --version 0.2.4`. The 0.2.4 guards are version-scoped and fail closed; readiness cannot advance the phase. Since attempt 4 the source is unchanged; the practical dead-link risk was closed operationally — identical annotated v0.2.4 tags on both remotes at the qualified commit 6f18529 and a credential-free HTTP 200 guide fetch — but the documented publish-before-mirror order, the governing-text/authorization sync and the README-link regression remain unimplemented, and the new guide receipt has no producer or verifier. Registry publication, main-branch tag delivery and 49 terminal CI contexts remain pending obligations.

findings.description: The documented 0.2.4 order still publishes the immutable crate (`cargo +1.99.0 publish`, :221) before any tool verifies the GitHub mirror ref that makes the packaged README link (README.md:31) resolvable; the mirror push is only at :229-235 and enforcement only at delivery (tools/release_delivery.py:190-208). scripts/check-prepublication.py:19-30 and scripts/check-access-release.py:49-124 perform no mirror check. For this release the risk is eliminated operationally (docs/checks/release-tag-v0.2.4.json and release-tag-github-v0.2.4.json at 6f18529, guide HTTP 200), but the procedure and the gate remain in the risky order for 0.2.4 reruns and future releases.
findings.required_fix: Move tag creation/push and both tag observations before `cargo publish` in docs/RELEASE.md:215-247, or add a bounded credential-free mirror-ref check to scripts/check-prepublication.py; assert the resulting order in tools/test_release_024.py:77-100.

findings.description: Code now requires and an operator has now performed a GitHub mirror push, but the governing texts do not record it: AGENTS.md:13 still names a single authorized push destination, docs/PHASES.md:299-303 lists only registry bytes, the canonical annotated tag and 49 CI contexts, and docs/typescript-035-parity-plan.md:148-157 omits the mirror and the fourth delivery receipt. The only authorization/disclosure record is docs/phase-status.json:8688-8701, which is not a governing contract and cites docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md on a different branch that is absent here, so the full-reachable-history disclosure is unverifiable in scope.
findings.required_fix: Record the mirror destination, the fourth delivery receipt and the full-history disclosure in AGENTS.md's push-destination clause, the docs/PHASES.md phase-28 paragraph and the plan's phase-28 section, and assert those sentences in tools/test_release_024.py alongside the existing documentation guards.

findings.description: This preflight receipt has no producer or verifier in the repository: its field set does not match scripts/observe-release.py (which writes the two tag receipts at :53-56), no check or test reads it, and nothing binds `contentSha256`/`bytes` to docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md or the URL to README.md:31. It is referenced only by prose at docs/phase-status.json:8696, so the 'public guide verified' claim is not reproducible by any gate (the 139-line guide is merely consistent with the recorded 7108 bytes).
findings.required_fix: Add a bounded `observe-release.py guide --version 0.2.4` mode that fetches the README-declared versioned URL, compares the digest with the file at the release commit, writes a fixed-schema receipt, and add negative regressions for a tampered digest/URL; reference it from the phase-28 delivery metadata.

findings.description: No regression binds the packaged README's absolute versioned link to the remote delivery actually verifies or to the crate version. tools/test_release_024.py:77-84 asserts 'Crate version: **0.2.4**' and the receipt-conditional sentences but checks neither the host (tools/release_delivery.py:20 GITHUB_REMOTE) nor the `v0.2.4` ref, so a version bump or mirror-host change would ship a stale link in an immutable archive while every gate passes.
findings.required_fix: In tools/test_release_024.py, derive the expected URL from release_delivery.GITHUB_REMOTE and the crates/scm-sdk/Cargo.toml version and assert README.md contains exactly that `blob/v<version>/docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md` link.

evidence: Check evidence is complete, passing and current-source bound: docs/reviews/phase-28-attempt-05.checks.json:1-6 records phase 28, source_sha256 f9cebee5..., source_unchanged true, passed true; I counted 105 `executed_at` entries and every `exit_code` is 0 with no `timeout: true` and no `source_unchanged: false`, all between 2026-10-22T15:25:34 and 15:57:13 (one continuous run, no checkpoint reuse — checkpoint_bindings are per-receipt digests only).

The registered phase-28 set actually ran, including the three phase-specific commands derived at tools/check_phase.py:319-328: checks.json:2862-2891 and :2893-2923 are `check-management-package.py --require-directional` on 1.89.0 (393.8 s) and 1.99.0 (372.5 s) binding receipts and retained .crate digests under .local/package-worktrees/6f18529a.../; :2924-2955 is `check-access-release.py --phase 28 --version 0.2.4` returning releaseCommit 6f18529, archiveSha256 533294fe, toolchains [1.89.0,1.99.0]. tools/test_release_024.py:148-156 asserts this set and that the candidate guard is last.

Directional execution is verified from the receipt itself, not prose: docs/checks/phase-28-release-package-1.99.0.json:63 packages examples/directional_profiles.rs, :767-775 binds it as an external consumer with checkIndex and selectedFeatures [], :980-990 shows the packaged `run --example directional_profiles --all-features --locked --offline` in the extracted archive, and :1116-1133 the external consumer run in /tmp/.../consumer with stdout 'Directional typed models and lossless response compatibility verified offline.', consumerSourceSha256 929b7b5f and consumerSourceUnchanged true; :1140 sourceSha256 equals the reviewed fingerprint. scripts/check-management-package.py:114,152-174 enforces 5 consumers and all seven executed-source digests.

The candidate guard is strict and version-scoped: scripts/check-access-release.py:30 registers (28,'0.2.4') only; :66-71 require schema-3 proofs, verify_receipt(require_directional=True), commit_fingerprint(releaseCommit)==fingerprint(root) and HEAD ancestry; :78-113 re-read retained archive bytes, file inventory, VCS identity and byte equality of every packaged member against the filesystem and the release commit plus all four manifests/lockfiles; :119-120 require both proofs to qualify identical files.

Readiness cannot complete the phase and delivery fails closed: tools/review_phase.py:304,459-460,478-479 restrict the release_readiness scope and forbid advancing on it; :483-489 call release_delivery.verify(phase=28, version='0.2.4'). tools/release_delivery.py:23 registers (28,'0.2.4'); :220-231 require release-registry-0.2.4.json, release-tag-v0.2.4.json and phase-28-remote-ci-run-N.json; :89-98 bind tag/registry/main; :105-116 require the CI contexts to equal the configured matrix exactly (.forgejo/workflows/ci.yml:90-91 yields 24 features x 2 toolchains + contracts-and-package = 49); :190-208 require the identical GitHub annotated tag. docs/phase-status.json:7791-7796,8351-8361 keep both chunks and all milestones pending.

The mirror preflight is real, tool-produced and bounded: docs/checks/release-tag-v0.2.4.json and release-tag-github-v0.2.4.json have exactly the field set written by scripts/observe-release.py:53-56 (git ls-remote, credential-free), both showing tagObject 2f7ad298 peeling to 6f18529 with refs/heads/main 56a88d2; docs/checks/phase-28-public-guide-preflight.json records HTTP 200 for raw.githubusercontent.com/.../v0.2.4/docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md. The 6f18529 -> 56a88d2 advance is a deliberate, enforced evidence-only descendant pattern (tools/review_phase.py:15-16 exclusions, release_delivery.commit_fingerprint:42-54, scripts/check-private-material.py:137-156, docs/RELEASE.md:208-213).

Publication prerequisites are chained in code: scripts/check-prepublication.py:20-30 accepts only (28,'0.2.4') and requires the readiness review twice around the candidate guard; scripts/verify-publication.py:56-70 maps 0.2.4 to verify_release_readiness(phase=28), :96-121,242-243 require schema-3 proofs and require_directional management verification; tools/release_delivery.py:143-156 re-verifies the embedded readiness provenance against docs/reviews/phase-28-attempt-N.json.

Security and dependency posture is fresh and source-bound: docs/checks/phase-28-private-material.json (verified at checks.json:242-265) reports 2439 git-visible files, zero credential and zero registration matches and zero new tenant occurrences, with scripts/check-private-material.py:205-214 recomputing both fingerprints and the history identity; docs/checks/phase-28-dependencies.json:3-53 is a 15:28 audit against RustSec 640bf5a9 (commitTime 2026-10-22T12:49) with pinned cargo-audit 0.22.2/cargo-deny 0.20.2 binary digests, 206 dependencies, vulnerabilities found false, plus per-lockfile audits (:54+).

Documentation is complete and receipt-conditional: CHANGELOG.md:3-47 states the four exports, exactly five field occurrences, both validation directions, the retained [] list default and the rustls-webpki 0.103.16 / webpki-root-certs 1.0.10 advisory refresh with downstream-lockfile guidance; docs/STABILITY.md:28-44 records the request tightening and the intentional tolerant-response difference; docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md:29-48,80-102 documents the six versioned roots and the two new schemas; README.md:20-22,51-53 keeps publication claims receipt-conditional. contracts/typescript-035-parity.json:19-27 counts 4/2/2/5/6/12/1 exactly as the plan requires, and crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/management/profiles.rs:91,214 repoint only the two request roots (response roots frozen at :76,92).

Live acceptance is honest: docs/checks/phase-28-live-attempt-01.json is read-only on 1.99.0, crateVersion 0.2.4, mutationsEnabled false, cleanupState not_needed, one verified OAuth probe and four HTTP 403 permission prerequisites, with explicit endpoint-profile limitations now mandatory for phase-27/28 receipts (tools/live_evidence.py:313-315); no security-profile endpoint was exercised, so directional service behavior is unestablished.
limitations: Read-only review: I executed nothing. I did not recompute the source fingerprint f9cebee5..., the checks digest 6f2172ba..., any receipt SHA-256 or the retained .crate digests; conclusions rest on reading the recorded receipts and tracing tools/check_phase.py:319-328 against the tools/review_phase.py evidence gate.

Pending delivery obligations, not completed outcomes: no docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json and no docs/checks/phase-28-remote-ci-run-N.json exist; crates.io publication has not occurred; the canonical annotated tag is not yet on a reviewed main-branch delivery commit per the delivery guard's own cross-checks; the 49 terminal CI contexts are unobserved (docs/phase-status.json:8698-8699 selects runs 30/31 without a receipt); the remote-delivery chunk is unreviewed.

No network calls were permitted, so I could not independently confirm the GitHub mirror's existence, visibility or the guide URL; I assessed only the recorded tag/guide receipts and repository-internal guards.

I could not verify the mirror authorization document cited at docs/phase-status.json:8690 (docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md on branch 382d9a08), which is outside this runtime branch, nor independently confirm that commit 56a88d2 changes only fingerprint-excluded evidence; I relied on the recorded metadata plus the exclusion and history-identity logic.

I did not open the retained archives under .local/package-worktrees/6f18529.../.local/artifacts/ or the extracted build trees; packaged and external directional execution is established by the recorded commands, cwds, stdout and digests plus the verifier logic in scripts/check-management-package.py:152-174.

Generated model correctness, the additive overlay, the oracle corpus and the schema graph are accepted phase-27 deliverables; I relied on this phase's compiler, package, oracle and fixture receipts and selected declarations rather than re-auditing crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs or src/validation/schema_graph.json.

Directional live acceptance remains explicitly unverified: the only current-source receipt is read-only with one verified OAuth probe and four HTTP 403 permission prerequisites, so no service application of the new settings is established.

The two medium findings are carried over unchanged from docs/reviews/phase-28-attempt-04.json and the accepted chunk record (44/50), and the maintainer recorded them as deliberately unimplemented; the source fingerprint is identical, so I re-derived them from AGENTS.md:13, docs/PHASES.md:291-303, docs/RELEASE.md:215-247 and tools/test_release_024.py:77-100 rather than adopting the prior text.

Phase 24/25 acceptance and pre-phase-26 release infrastructure were out of scope beyond the pinned 0.2.3 receipt identity and the historical defaults asserted by tools/test_release_024.py:102-110; scripts/check-package.py changed, so historical phase-24 package receipts no longer match their recorded packageScriptSha256, which that phase regenerates.
